newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Datang Power set for March HK/UK listing - source.
newsitem.headline: Datang Power set for March HK/UK listing - source.

text.p: China's Beijing Datang Power Generation Co is expected to seek a dual listing in Hong Kong and London in March, a market source said on Tuesday.
"The company is set for a hearing at the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong on February 13 and an international roadshow will start on February 17," the source close to the deal said.
The roadshow will start in Hong Kong or Singapore followed by a dual listing of shares in the Hong Kong and London markets some time in March, he added.
Morgan Stanley, the lead manager of the flotation, declined to comment.

Datang's dual listing plan has been delayed after the original global coordinator, Salomon Brothers, was dropped last December. Salomon said it believed it had been dropped due to disagreements over the pricing of the offer.
Beijing Datang had been expected to raise about US$300 million through the share flotation, market sources said.
Wheelock NatWest and Kleinwort Benson are involved in the flotation, they said.
